notes:
SWIT QB Companion 2.0.0-beta.125

Fix – journal entries: with ClassRequired on, a journal entry asked for a class on every line, including the bank line. Now a class is only needed on income and expense lines, such as bank charges and interest. The bank line and other balance sheet lines (GCT, withholding tax, liabilities) can be left without one.
Bank rules: a Class for a direct payment. A rule that records a line as a Direct payment now has a Class box under its GL account, as journal entry and sales receipt rules already had. When you use Record as → Direct payment on a line the rule catches, the form opens with that class filled in. If the rule has an analytic plan, the plan still sets its own classes.
The bank rules list now shows each rule’s class under its account.
